saw_lines: Premium TV buyers compare panels and sound for weeks, then pick one brand and rarely shop the category again.
So the sale is won in the first line, where a buyer decides whether a brand is worth a click.
Your 30 live ads carry no proof number, so collect one real figure, like a review count or units shipped, and put it on the next three ads.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 15 Oct 2026
points: None of your 30 live ads carries a proof number, so a buyer weighing a premium TV has nothing concrete to trust. Collect one real figure, like a review count or units shipped, and put it on the next three ads.

5 of your 30 ads are creator posts run from the brand page, so they read as a company selling, not a person recommending. Whitelist those 5 from the creator accounts, then cut 3 variations of each with different openers.

8 of your 30 copy ads open on one line, “oplev det uopnåelige med alexander”, and the rest are single use. Test two new angles against that opener, such as price and a customer quote, and keep whichever wins.
0 of your 30 ads carry an offer, so a first time buyer has no reason to act today. Give new buyers a reason to act now, such as a first order offer or bundle, and put it on the next three ads.

ads_1: Price and customer quote angles to test against the Zverev opener
soc_1: Brand social strategy for the channels your buyers already use
